title: Date/time handling must go through moment_wrapper, not raw Date/moment
answers: How should I create or manipulate dates in grafana-data / grafana code?
Why shouldn't I use moment or Date directly?
body: Use dateTime()/toUtc() from packages/grafana-data/src/datetime/moment_wrapper.ts (e.g. toUtc at line ~117) instead of raw `moment` or `Date`. The wrapper sits on top of moment_implementation.ts and an in-progress luxon compatibility shim (src/datetime/luxon_moment_compat/). Bypassing it breaks timezone handling and will conflict with the ongoing moment→luxon migration.
applies: Applies to any new code in grafana-data or its consumers doing date/time creation or formatting; does not cover already-committed legacy code still using moment directly elsewhere in the app, which is being migrated incrementally.
